**Convenience bias | practice variation 4.**

A school surveys only students who answer a voluntary poll about all students' sleep habits. Identify a sampling problem and suggest an improvement.

scheme.text: The selection frame may exclude other pupils, so it need not represent the whole population.

title: SL 4.2 · histogram density 1
prompt:
**Histogram density | practice variation 1.**

A histogram class has width 2 units and frequency 12. Find its frequency density and explain which quantity the bar area shows.

scheme.text: Density is frequency divided by class width: $12/2=6$.
Bar area is width times density, $2(6)=12$.
Thus area, not height alone, equals frequency when class widths differ.
